reply_text:
㊢ (passing the notes to claude-17) Sent. The bell to claude-17 carries the eight polish notes, a pointer to the Dark Tower 3 brief with the questions that touch their work, and the three-part strategy. The job is `invoke-1791087618050-31509-bb9e736f`; it was running in claude-17's seat a few seconds after I sent it.

㊟ (how I framed it) I told claude-17 these are review notes, not instructions, and that you have not ruled on the strategy. I also said the two points about Fong's papers are from my memory and need checking against the sources before the notebook prose changes. I asked for no reply and did not park on the job, so anything claude-17 does with the notes will show up in their REPL, not mine.
